name: obs-vllm-metrics-design-doc
notes: The project's own metrics design note. Contains the explicit ITL-vs-per-request-TPOT difference, the deprecation policy (hidden one version, removed two), the list of removed legacy metrics (vllm:num_requests_swapped, vllm:cpu_cache_usage_perc, vllm:avg_prompt_throughput_toks_per_s), and the argument that colons in metric names are contrary to Prometheus convention.
